title: Constructibility under the explicit etale scalar equivalence
statement: For a Noetherian scheme X, a Noetherian commutative ring k in universe u+1 and a sheaf F of fixed-k modules on the original small etale site, its explicit scalar model [def-sfb-fixed-scalar-etale-model] is coefficient constructible [def-pe-etale-constructible-module] if and only if F is IsConstructibleSheaf (finite stratification with locally constant finitely generated geometric stalks). No finiteness of the underlying coefficient set is assumed.

proof.text: Use the general-ring global coefficient stratification theorem and transport local finite constant module models along the small-site equivalences and the stratum inverse-image square. All these helpers in the existing presentation proof are independent of coefficient finiteness.

Identify local finite constant models with finite local constancy on the original etale site. A covering sieve gives an etale cover with the same finite models. Lift a separably closed geometric point through this cover and use the constant-value stalk isomorphism to transport finite generation. Conversely remove empty cover members and identify each constant value with a finitely generated geometric stalk.
Keep the same finite stratification and transport the resulting constructible sheaf back across the scalar realization unit.

lean.statement:
theorem fixedScalarEtale_constructible_sheaf (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (k : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing k] [IsNoetherianRing k]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k)) :
    IsCoefficientConstructibleEtaleModule.{u, u} X k
      ((fixedScalarEtaleSheafEquivalence X k).functor.obj F) ↔ IsConstructibleSheaf F
